name: Daniel
source:
[url=/c83806]Arnaud[/url]'s father and Alice's husband. A general in the French army.
He has a dignity that overpowers his surroundings, he's very confident.
Because of his training in the army he is strict with everyone.
It's the same with his son, the only person he shows a kind face to is his wife.
